trusted_assumptions: vstd contracts for Vec::as_slice and slice length/indexing.
The vstd PartialEqSpec contract for element comparison when T::obeys_eq_spec() holds.
Rust's BytewiseEq safety invariant makes specialized bytewise slice comparison equivalent to elementwise PartialEq.
rationale: Desugars the Vec macro body through Rust 1.96's slice length check and generic equality loop; loop invariants prove the inherited PartialEqSpec contract without local axioms.
